##### Project general facts


Prime Residency 3 is a contemporary residential development located in the heart of Al Furjan, offering a modern urban lifestyle by Prescott Real Estate. The architecture is defined by a clean and functional design, consisting of a ground level, two podium floors, seven residential levels, and a rooftop area. The project features a selection of studios and 1-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully planned with efficient layouts and smart home integration, allowing residents to easily control lighting, air conditioning, and other in-home systems for enhanced comfort and convenience.

The development offers a well-rounded set of amenities designed to support both relaxation and everyday living. Residents have access to a fully equipped gym, a dedicated children’s playroom, and a swimming pool that provides a refreshing leisure space within the community. Additional facilities include covered parking, 24/7 security, and a video surveillance system, ensuring both safety and convenience. A landscaped green area further enhances the environment, offering a peaceful outdoor space for walking and relaxation.

Inside, Prime Residency 3 features functional and modern interiors designed for comfortable urban living. Kitchens come fully equipped, providing practicality for everyday use. The apartments are available with the option of furnished layouts, allowing residents flexibility depending on their preferences. While detailed finishing information is not specified, the overall design focuses on simplicity, efficiency, and smart living solutions that align with contemporary lifestyle needs.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
